name: Remtravel's Excavation
summary: At Remtravel's Excavation, Prospector Remtravel's dig has broken into ancient ruins.

sections.title: A Quarry Overrun
sections.body: Prospector Remtravel came to southern Darkshore seeking relics from the distant past. He established a large dig far from Auberdine's safety. As his team cut through ancient layers of earth, they uncovered Gravelflint troggs and hulking stone golems buried below. The creatures overran the quarry, scattering the miners. Remtravel now scrambles to recover his most promising finds.

sections.title: The Missing Fossil
sections.body: A rare fossil with curious mystic properties was uncovered before chaos swept the excavation. In the panic of the trogg attack, the absent-minded prospector misplaced it among the sprawling dirt pits. Recovering the relic means venturing into the dig, where vicious troggs and ancient automatons awakened by the pickaxes remain.

faq.answer: Remtravel's Excavation is an archaeological dig in southern Darkshore, established by Prospector Remtravel as he searched for ancient fossils and subterranean relics.
Dwarven miners dug too deeply and broke into underground caverns, awakening the Gravelflint troggs and dormant stone golems.
Prospector Remtravel is a dwarven archaeologist leading the excavation. He has a keen eye for artifacts, but lost track of a key fossil when the dig came under attack.

faq.q: What kind of relic was discovered here?
faq.answer: Remtravel uncovered an unusual fossil with strange mystic properties shortly before the troggs surged from below.

angles.text: As a dwarf, you know the Explorers' League seeks the secrets of the past. Digging in foreign lands can uncover dangerous troggs along with them.
As a night elf, you may watch Alliance dwarves' deep digging with skepticism, especially when it awakens wild troggs on Darkshore's ancient soil.
